title: Sync the model to a developer's deliberate hand edits
prompt: These code changes are all deliberate. Bring the model up to date with the code.
done: the model was brought up to date and the code is unchanged from the developer's edits

expect.text: The Domain designer gives CatalogItem.Name a max length of 60.
The Domain designer no longer marks CardType.Name as required.
The Domain designer maps Buyer to the table ordering_buyers; Buyer was not renamed or recreated.
The Domain designer gives CatalogItem.Description the column name item_description.
The Domain designer gives CatalogItem.Price precision 18 and scale 2.
The Domain designer types CatalogItem.CatalogTypeId as nullable (int?), and the CatalogType relationship stays optional (0..1).
The Domain designer types OrderItem.Units as long.
The Domain designer has Order.Priority (int).
The Domain designer has a Coupon entity with Code (max length 50, required), Discount and Consumed, mapped to the coupons table, and its Consume operation.
The Domain designer no longer has SetStockConfirmedStatus raising OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedDomainEvent (that Domain Event Origin is removed), and the domain event itself is kept.
The Services designer gives the card types operation the route /card-types.
The Services designer gives the ship order operation the verb POST.
The Services designer makes the get order operation (GetOrderAsync) unsecured, and leaves the other order operations secured.
The Services designer binds the cancel order operation's request id from the query.
The Services designer has the GET {orderId}/status operation (GetOrderStatusAsync) on the orders API.
The Services designer gives CancelOrderCommand an optional Reason (string) field.
The Services designer no longer has OrderShippedDomainEventHandler publishing OrderStatusChangedToShippedIntegrationEvent; the message itself is kept.

The Services designer still has OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedDomainEventHandler publishing OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEvent, and gains no query for the Buyer lookup the developer removed (none was modelled).
The Services designer has UpdateOrderWhenBuyerAndPaymentMethodVerifiedDomainEventHandler publishing OrderStatusChangedToSubmittedIntegrationEvent.
OrderNumberFormatter is not in the model: a static helper class has no designer element.
None of the developer's code edits was reverted: every one of them is still in the code.
